name: Slow
description:
Choose a point within long range. Roll Lore vs Spirit against each creature within short range of that point. Your roll result becomes the Difficulty. On each win:

  • The creature's speed is halved, it takes -2 to Defense, -2d to Dexterity rolls.

  • The creature takes -1 half action on each of its turns and can't use reactions. Regardless of any abilities or equipment, the creature cannot make more than one melee or ranged attack per turn.

  • If the creature attempts to cast a spell that costs 1 action, the spell doesn’t take effect until the creature’s next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell. If it can’t, the spell is wasted.

Each affected creature may roll Spirit against the Difficulty at the end of each of its turns to end the effects.
successes:
✨: On each win, the creature's speed is reduced by an additional 5 ft.

🌞: On each win, the creature becomes Weary while the spell lasts.

💀: The spell instead targets each creature within short range of you, including you.
